## 问题与结果 / Problem and Result

说明具体问题、触发条件与修改后的行为。关联 Issue（如有）：
Describe the concrete problem, trigger, and resulting behavior. Related issue, if any:

## 验证 / Validation

填写本次实际执行的命令、结果与未覆盖范围。界面或文档布局变化请附截图。
List commands actually run, results, and untested scope. Include screenshots for visible changes.

- [ ] 已阅读维护规则、更新日志、验证记录和发布回归清单 / Read maintenance rules, changelog, validation record, and release checklist
- [ ] 核心和完整界面回归通过，或说明未执行原因 / Core and full UI checks pass, or explain why they were not run
- [ ] 按影响验证联网、安装及单 EXE，保留第三方许可与源码 / Validate live, installation, and single-EXE behavior as applicable; preserve notices and source
- [ ] 未改写历史更新条目，未将旧功能重复列为新增 / Preserve historical changelog entries

发布与关闭关联 Issue 等待维护者确认。Release publication and closing associated issues require maintainer confirmation.
